verses.1: Then the LORD said to me, “Take a large scroll and write on it with an ordinary + 8:1 Hebrew with a man’s stylus: Maher-shalal-hash-baz. + 8:1 Maher-shalal-hash-baz means The spoil speeds, the prey hastens or Swift to plunder, quick to carry away ; also in verse 3.
verses.2: And I will appoint for Myself trustworthy witnesses— Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah.”
verses.3: And I had relations with the prophetess, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. The LORD said to me, “Name him Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
verses.4: For before the boy knows how to cry ‘Father’ or ‘Mother,’ the wealth of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried off by the king of Assyria.”
verses.5: And the LORD spoke to me further:
verses.6:
“Because this people has rejected
 the gently flowing waters of Shiloah
 and rejoiced in Rezin
 and the son of Remaliah,
verses.7:
the Lord will surely bring against them
 the mighty floodwaters of the Euphrates + 8:7 Hebrew the River —
 the king of Assyria and all his pomp.
 It will overflow its channels
 and overrun its banks.
verses.8:
It will pour into Judah,
 swirling and sweeping over it,
 reaching up to the neck;
 its spreading streams will cover
 your entire land, O Immanuel! + 8:8 Immanuel means God with us .
verses.10:
Devise a plan, but it will be thwarted;
 state a proposal, but it will not happen.
 For God is with us. + 8:10 Hebrew Immanuel ; see Matthew 1:23|MAT 1:23 . ”
 A Call to Fear God
 ( Ecclesiastes 8:10–13|ECC 8:10-13 )
verses.11: For this is what the LORD has spoken to me with a strong hand, instructing me not to walk in the way of this people:
verses.12:
“Do not call conspiracy
 everything these people regard as conspiracy.
 Do not fear what they fear; + 8:12 Or Do not fear their threats 
 do not live in dread. + 8:12 LXX do not be shaken ; cited in 1 Peter 3:14|1PE 3:14
verses.13:
The LORD of Hosts is the One
 you shall regard as holy.
 Only He should be feared;
 only He should be dreaded.
verses.14:
And He will be a sanctuary —
 but to both houses of Israel
 a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense, + 8:14 Cited in Romans 9:33|ROM 9:33 and 1 Peter 2:8 
 to the dwellers of Jerusalem
 a trap and a snare.
verses.16:
Bind up the testimony
 and seal the law among my disciples.
verses.17:
I will wait for the LORD,
 who is hiding His face from the house of Jacob.
 I will put my trust in Him. + 8:17 Or I will eagerly look for Him ; cited in Hebrews 2:13|HEB 2:13
verses.18:
Here am I, and the children the LORD has given me + 8:18 Cited in Hebrews 2:13|HEB 2:13 as signs and symbols in Israel from the LORD of Hosts, who dwells on Mount Zion.
 Darkness and Light
verses.19: When men tell you to consult mediums and spiritists who whisper and mutter, shouldn’t a people consult their God instead? Why consult the dead on behalf of the living?
verses.20: To the law and to the testimony! If they do not speak according to this word, they have no light of dawn.
verses.21: They will roam the land, dejected and hungry. When they are famished, they will become enraged; and looking upward, they will curse their king and their God.
verses.22: Then they will look to the earth and see only distress and darkness and the gloom of anguish. And they will be driven into utter darkness.
